$comment: The v4 slice as end-to-end tests, in priority order. A building session changes ONLY the `passes` field, and sets it true only after `test` passes locally and in CI. Never delete, reword or reorder a feature to make it pass; a feature that turns out wrong gets a new feature plus a note in progress.md. `blockedBy` names what must happen before work starts. See docs/development/workflow.md.

features.description: One schema generates the TS and Go contracts, and every fixture validates in both
steps: make gen twice leaves the tree clean
check-fixtures passes all fixtures with ajv
the Go round-trip test passes and rejects every invalid-required fixture
a schema edit without make gen fails check-gen

features.description: make e2e boots wrangler dev on a free port, waits for /healthz, runs the named e2e tests and prints E2E_MS
steps: make e2e starts the Worker with --persist-to a temp dir
GET /healthz returns 200 within 10 s
a failing step names itself and prints the last 20 events
the run ends with E2E_MS=<n> STEPS=<k>/<k>

features.description: A test user creates a pod and receives hello over the pod WebSocket
steps: POST /__test/seed mints a user and returns a cmu_ token (local and preview builds only)
POST /v1/pods with that token creates a pod and returns its id
GET /v1/pods/:pod/ws with the token upgrades and the first frame is hello with headSeq 0 and the user as owner

features.description: Human messages fan out live, and a reconnecting client resumes from sinceSeq with no gaps
steps: two members subscribe; one sends message.post
both receive message.created with the same seq
the second client disconnects, three more posts happen, it reconnects with subscribe{sinceSeq}
it receives exactly the three missed events, in order
the same holds after the Durable Object hibernates

features.description: Invites add members; used, expired and non-member cases are refused
steps: the owner creates an invite and a second user accepts it
the second user's hello lists them as a member
accepting the same single-use invite again returns 410
a non-member creating an invite gets 403

features.description: A member creates a task assigned to an agent and every member sees task.created
steps: a registered agent exists in the pod
a member sends task.create with the agent as assignee
all subscribers receive task.created with status open and the assignee set

features.description: Only addressed changes wake an agent, wakes coalesce, and unacked wakes are re-sent
steps: an ambient human message produces no run.wake
assigning three tasks to the agent in a row produces one pending wake, delivered once
a wake not acked within 60 s is re-sent on the next heartbeat (clock is test-controlled)
run.wake goes only to the computer that hosts the agent

features.description: The daemon registers its computer and an agent, and the pod shows the agent online
steps: commonly daemon start --foreground registers the computer and stores cmc_ at mode 0600
commonly agent add fake registers an agent in the pod
members receive presence.changed online for the agent within 5 s
killing the daemon produces presence.changed offline within 45 s

features.description: On run.wake the daemon claims a run and starts the agent with a run token and the pod MCP server
steps: the daemon receives run.wake and calls POST /v1/runs
the response carries runId, a cmr_ token, a brief and the MCP URL
the fake ACP agent starts with the MCP server passed in session/new
commonly_whoami over MCP returns the agent, pod and run
the agent's argv and env contain cmr_ and never cmc_

features.description: commonly_task_claim is exclusive and its lease renews on every tool call
steps: two runs claim the same task concurrently; exactly one wins
the loser gets already_claimed naming the holder
members receive task.claimed with leaseUntil
a later tool call on the winning run moves leaseUntil forward

features.description: commonly_post enforces the headline contract and the pod stamps the receipt
steps: a post without summary gets summary_required; one over 120 chars gets invalid_input
an ask without options, or a non-ask with needs, gets invalid_input
a post carrying receipt is rejected
a valid ask creates a message whose receipt has the runId, harness fake, wakeReason and toolCalls equal to the MCP calls made so far
the ask carries an open decision

features.description: A human rules on an ask once, and the agent is woken with the ruling and finishes the task
steps: a member sends decision.rule with an option id
members receive message.updated with the decision ruled and frozen
a second ruling returns already_ruled and changes nothing
the agent receives run.wake with reason decision_ruled
the agent calls commonly_task_update done and members receive task.updated done

features.description: Tokens are scoped: a run cannot cross pods, an ended run is dead, and test routes are absent in production
steps: a cmr_ for pod A posting to pod B gets forbidden
after POST /v1/runs/:run/end the same cmr_ gets unauthorized
an actor field in MCP tool arguments is ignored
the production build of the Worker contains no /__test handler

features.description: The whole slice runs end to end with the fake agent in under 60 s
steps: sign in, create pod, invite, join
start the daemon and add the fake agent
create a task assigned to it
observe run.wake, task.claimed, then an ask with a receipt
rule on the ask, observe the second wake and task.updated done
E2E_MS under 60000

features.description: commonly login signs in with GitHub's device flow and stores a user token safely
steps: against a stub GitHub, commonly login prints the user code and verification URL
after the stub approves, the CLI exchanges the GitHub token at POST /v1/auth/github for a cmu_
the token file is mode 0600 and the token is never printed
a revoked or invalid GitHub token gets unauthorized

features.description: A recorded real Claude Code session (claude-agent-acp) replays through the daemon and makes the slice's pod calls
steps: daemon/testdata/acp/claude-slice.jsonl is recorded against the pinned adapter, scrubbed
the replay test drives the daemon with it and the pod calls match the golden list
one operator walks the slice by hand with real Claude Code and the result is noted in progress.md

features.description: Every PR deploys a Workers preview and F14 passes against it
steps: the preview job deploys the PR to its own preview with its own DO namespace and the preview D1
COMMONLY_URL=<preview> go test ./e2e -run TestF14 passes

features.description: A person uses the slice from the client chosen in the client options review
steps: defined after docs/design/client-options.md is reviewed with Sam

features.description: An agent reads Linear through a pod grant without ever holding the Linear token
steps: defined after docs/design/connector-options.md is reviewed with Sam

features.description: A recorded real Codex session (codex-acp) replays through the daemon and makes the slice's pod calls
steps: daemon/testdata/acp/codex-slice.jsonl is recorded against the pinned adapter, scrubbed
the replay test passes
